scenario: The first write creates the curriculum without a version; later writes need If-Match
steps: 1. PUT /curriculum/{cohort} with two modules 2. PUT again without If-Match 3. PUT with a wrong If-Match
expected: 201 then 428 then 409; an unknown cohort gives 404

scenario: Add at a position; rename; reorder atomically; delete
steps: 1. POST modules with position 0 2. PATCH a module 3. POST modules/reorder with a missing id 4. POST modules/reorder with all ids 5. DELETE a module
expected: Order follows position; a bad reorder is 400 and changes nothing; delete works

scenario: Add; change title and assignment; move between modules; delete; ids unique; links checked
steps: 1. POST a lesson with an assignment 2. POST the same id again 3. POST an http or foreign link 4. PATCH with assignment null 5. POST lessons/reorder moving a lesson 6. DELETE it
expected: Duplicates and bad links are 400; the id cannot be patched; the move is atomic

scenario: Working copy and published copy are separate; discard goes back
steps: 1. POST publish 2. Add a module 3. GET shows hasUnpublishedChanges 4. POST discard 5. Empty the draft and POST publish
expected: Published copy unchanged by edits; discard restores; an empty draft cannot be published (422)

scenario: A lesson learners have progress on cannot be deleted or dropped
preconditions: A learner has video_progress on a lesson
steps: 1. DELETE the lesson 2. DELETE its module 3. PUT without it 4. PATCH its title
expected: 422 on the first three, nothing changes; rename is fine

scenario: isExam and serverGraded cannot be set or changed through the API
preconditions: A lesson marked as exam in the database
steps: 1. PATCH with isExam true 2. GET then PUT the same data 3. PUT with the flags removed 4. PATCH assignment null on the exam

scenario: Audit holds a summary without links; a staff key can read but not write
preconditions: An admin and a staff key
steps: 1. Read /audit for the cohort 2. Use the staff key to GET and to PUT
expected: Counts and versions only; GET 200 and PUT 403

scenario: Today's three real courses convert and come back identical (what is kept)
expected: Every lesson, kept assignment and resource is identical; nothing is lost without a line in the dropped list
